nativeExecutable.identityContract: The existing product fingerprint also binds the OS version string. Receipt replay requires that platform identity, not just the same executable bytes.

externalInputs.reconstruction: Restore the gzip-content-addressed manifest entries. Scientific reports and the first complete model inside native/ are themselves deterministic gzip files; decompress these to their original JSON names. Other model files are not retained in full; recreate selected training using subset/write from run_native_target_kernel.py and the full training.json.gz, then fit with each saved plan and verify its recorded model hash. Native replay requires the exact implementation identity; source preparation also requires the recorded HDF5 library.

qualification: Exact evidence bytes with deduplicated storage. External source H5AD files and executable are not bundled. Native replay requires their restoration and the recorded executable identity.
retention: Full source H5AD/report and native executable remain external. native/training.json.gz retains exact prepared training bytes. All folds retain prediction report JSON as gzip plus input plans, queries, receipts and hashes. Only first-model retains complete fitted model JSON. See NATIVE_TARGET_KERNEL.md for reconstruction of other models.
